Hector Alvarez: Quick: BlueRiver wants an air-gapped POC. Questions: can we ship signed minibundles via courier, support BYO-HSM, and do we bill a sealed-environment fee? They included a short SQ.

Priya Iyer: We can sign and courier for POC. BYO-HSM supported via KMIP or customer-loaded key into their HSM. Need to confirm minibundle max size (logistics prefers <200MB).

Jonah Kim: Tech note: emergency CVE hotfix via courier possible in 48-72h under SLA. We can produce Notary v2 manifests + SBOMs. If we manage keys for them, add HSM custody addendum and chain-of-custody paperwork.

Marta (Solutions): Pricing sketch: one-time POC packaging: $8k, POC support 2w: $3k, sealed-env addendum (optional): $5k one-time or $2k/mo for ongoing. Final numbers after SQ answers.

Hector Alvarez: Thanks  I'll ask BlueRiver for transport preference, max bundle size, and their security lead contact and post answers here.

Priya Iyer: Also ask if they want us to provide tooling to self-sign after POC and whether they require long-term archive of manifests (default 5y).
